data.narrative:
Dominion Dynamics is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Eliot Pence (former Anduril International leader) and Mitch Carkner (ex-Amazon/IBM, Canadian Forces veteran), having raised $18M to date. The peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private—including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, spanning Seed through Series A stages.

Two valuation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis uses the $18M raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying $45M. Peer-median analysis draws from 4 same-sector comparables at matching or adjacent stages: Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A). This yields a median valuation of $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

Triangulating both methods produces a valuation range of $38M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $372M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty in comparable selection, particularly the high variance in peer stage and valuation. Stage-progression implies substantially lower value than peer medians, suggesting either that Dominion's founding team commands a premium relative to historical Seed-stage cohorts, or that peer comps may not be fully comparable on risk or capital efficiency metrics. Key sensitivities include peer selection criteria and the appropriate stage-progression multiplier given management pedigree.
